local_description_comparison: All local URDF link and joint element tags/attributes match the pinned upstream description semantically. Byte hashes differ from formatting/comments. Base-link and left-front-wheel STL bytes match upstream exactly. Imported local file SHA256 values are recorded separately in vendor/waveshare_ugv/provenance.json.

native_drive.rationale: Use actual CAD axle spacing and STL tire radius, not the conflicting Classic plugin diameter. Vendor ugv_base_general/General_Driver/ugv_config.h also specifies UGV Rover WHEEL_D=0.0800 and nominal TRACK_WIDTH=0.172. Effective skid-steer track needs physical calibration. Friction and velocity limits are conservative simulation settings, not calibrated motor behavior.

native_sensors.rgbd: 640x360 at 3Hz default, explicit per-rover real-recording rectified intrinsics and optical TF, ideal registered depth. Rate is adjustable. This is not the original Classic camera profile, a stereo-camera failure model, or a full IMU/LiDAR simulation.

official_vm_inspection.format: VMware split sparse VMDK, 21 extents, approximately 26GiB allocated and 80GiB logical
official_vm_inspection.compatibility: Cannot hardware-virtualize this x86-64 guest directly on Apple Silicon; running it would require CPU emulation. ARM Ubuntu is a separate rebuild, not this image.
official_vm_inspection.inspection: Read descriptor/VM configuration and filenames only; no VM boot, no writable disk mount, no image modifications.

scope: Native Gazebo Harmonic port of the real CAD description plus recorded camera calibration, targeting CrossMaps algorithm tests. Does not claim bit-identical reproduction of the vendor Ubuntu VM, Classic plugins, Docker SLAM stack, hardware drivers, camera failures, or real-world traction.
